_comment: ENRICHMENT LAYER — This file is NOT the primary source of core capabilities. It enriches runtime data derived from each core's Core.plist. Fields in this file are merged on top of auto-derived capabilities. Add or update entries here only to supply: summary, qualityRank, notes, and capability flags that cannot be expressed in Core.plist (e.g. highAccuracy, mouseSupport, lightgunSupport). Capabilities already declared in Core.plist (PVCapabilities key) take effect automatically and do not need to be repeated here. gameRequirements are editorial data and should remain here.

cores.summary: Best GBA emulator: high accuracy, RTC, link cable, and e-Reader support.
Legacy GBA emulator. Fast, but lower accuracy than mGBA.
notes: Legacy core — mGBA is recommended for most games

cores.summary: Fast SNES emulator. Wide game compatibility with mouse and multitap support.
RetroArch-wrapped Snes9x. Adds run-ahead and widescreen options.
Cycle-accurate SNES emulation. Highest compatibility but CPU-intensive.
notes: May be slow on older devices

cores.summary: BSNES with HD mode-7 rendering and widescreen support.
BSNES Mercury — accuracy profile. Near-perfect emulation.
BSNES Mercury — balanced profile. Good accuracy with better performance.
Classic NES emulator. Reliable compatibility for most titles.
High-accuracy DS emulator with real microphone, local wireless, and camera support.
notes: Alpha — may be disabled in some build variants
Best choice for games using microphone or camera

cores.summary: Legacy DS emulator. Better compatibility with some older homebrew.
notes: Alpha — may be disabled in some build variants
Older engine — melonDS is preferred for most titles
No real microphone or local wireless

cores.summary: Classic N64 emulator with Transfer Pak and rumble support.
Mupen64Plus-Next. Improved accuracy and GLideN64 graphics plugin.
Mupen64Plus-Next via RetroArch. Run-ahead and widescreen support.
ParaLLEl-N64 — LLE GPU and RSP for near-perfect N64 accuracy.
DuckStation PS1 emulator. Hardware-accurate with enhanced resolution.
notes: Alpha — not yet enabled in all build variants

cores.summary: Lightweight PS1 emulator. Fastest option for low-end devices.
notes: Best for devices with limited CPU

cores.summary: Beetle PSX with hardware renderer. Widescreen and enhanced resolution.
Beetle PSX software renderer. Most accurate PS1 emulation available.
Genesis Plus GX. Accurate Mega Drive / Sega CD / Game Gear emulation.
PicoDrive. Specialises in 32X titles; also supports Genesis.
Flycast JIT — fast Dreamcast emulation with enhanced resolution.
Flycast without JIT — available on App Store, slightly slower.
notes: Some games may run slowly without JIT

cores.summary: Dolphin via RetroArch. GameCube and Wii emulation.

gameRequirements.tip: Mario Paint uses the SNES Mouse — choose a core with mouse support for the best experience.
Yoshi's Safari uses the Super Scope light gun — pick a core with light gun support.
Battle Clash uses the Super Scope — choose a core with light gun support.
Wario's Woods supports the SNES Mouse for more precise control.
Bomberman supports up to 5 players via Multitap — pick a core with multitap support.
Nintendogs uses the DS microphone to respond to your voice — choose a core with real microphone support.
Some WarioWare microgames use the microphone — choose a core with real mic support.
Electroplankton uses the DS microphone for sound input — choose a core with real microphone support.
A core with real microphone and local wireless support gives the best DS experience.
Choose a high-accuracy PS1 core for the best compatibility and visual quality.
mGBA provides the most accurate GBA emulation and is recommended for all GBA titles.
